metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a Node.js (22+) RS274/NGC G-code simulator CLI in `output/` with JSON end-state output and optional sampled motion trace.

- Entry point: `output/main.js` (run as `node main.js ...` from repo root via `node output/main.js ...`)
- Core modules:
  - `output/parser.js` (block parsing, comments, block-delete `/`, parameter sets `#...=...`)
  - `output/expr.js` (RS274-style expressions + unary functions)
  - `output/simulator.js` (modal state, motion execution, canned cycles, probing)
  - `output/trace.js` (trace stepping + delta encoding)
  - `output/tooltable.js` (RS274 tool file format §2.3)
  - `output/parameters.js` (RS274 parameter file format §3.2.1 read/write)
- Supports required CLI args:
  - `--input <gcode_file> --output <result_file>`
- Supports harness optional args:
  - `--tool-table`, `--block-delete`, `--carousel-slots`
  - `--parameter-input`, `--parameter-output`
  - `--probe-box ...`, `--probe-tool`
  - `--trace-output` with exactly one of `--trace-time-step`, `--trace-distance-step`, `--trace-position-tolerance`
- Writes `--output` JSON on both success and error; exits `0` on success, `1` on spec/program/input errors, `2` on internal errors.
- Writes `--trace-output` JSON on both success and error when enabled.
